title: OntoAct: Hypothesis-Based Neuro-Symbolic Agents through Ontological Abstraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.21983v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning from experience requires recovering reusable knowledge and determining when it applies to a new situation. We introduce OntoAct, a hypothesis-based neuro-symbolic framework built on ontological abstraction. OntoAct turns individual experiences into axioms over entity types, relations, and conditions, making their underlying patterns reusable across situations. A large language model (LLM) uses this world knowledge to propose hypotheses and actions, while a symbolic verifier assesses their supporting conditions against current observations. Verification identifies missing evidence, and new observations and intervention outcomes update hypothesis assessments and guide subsequent actions. We also introduce Tacit-FLE, a benchmark built on the Factorio Learning Environment (FLE) for diagnosing and repairing hidden faults in existing factories using inherited operational records. translated_title: OntoAct：基于本体抽象的假设驱动神经符号智能体
translated_abstract: 从经验中学习需要恢复可复用的知识，并确定这些知识何时适用于新情境。我们提出了OntoAct，一个基于本体抽象的假设驱动神经符号框架。OntoAct将个体经验转化为关于实体类型、关系和条件的公理，使其底层模式可以在不同情境之间复用。大语言模型（LLM）利用这种世界知识来提出假设和动作，而符号验证器则根据当前观察来评估其支持条件。验证过程识别缺失的证据，新的观察和干预结果会更新假设评估并指导后续动作。我们还介绍了Tacit-FLE，一个构建于Factorio学习环境（FLE）之上的基准，用于利用继承的运行记录来诊断和修复现有工厂中的隐藏故障。其合成的维护语料库将证据分布在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: OntoAct通过本体抽象将经验转化为可复用的知识公理，让大语言模型提出假设和动作、由符号验证器检验证据并动态更新评估，从而实现跨情境的知识复用与假设驱动的决策，并配套发布了用于诊断修复工厂隐藏故障的Tacit-FLE基准。
en_tdlr: OntoAct is a hypothesis-based neuro-symbolic framework that turns experiences into reusable ontological axioms, with an LLM proposing hypotheses and actions while a symbolic verifier checks supporting evidence and iteratively refines assessments, accompanied by the Tacit-FLE benchmark for diagnosing and repairing hidden factory faults.
